definition: to cause something to move by pulling
description: On a canal towpath on a misty morning, with an old brick bridge arching over the water, a laughing young man in a checked flannel shirt, a grey hoodie, work trousers and boots leans forward and hauls a green narrowboat along the bank with a thick rope over his shoulder. The boat moves slowly forward. Three young men in winter jackets sit on the boat roof, one raising a mug and cheering. A grey heron stands on the far bank, and a coil of rope and an iron winch lie on the path.

taps.target: the man in the brown jacket
